text:
Jordan M: Quick plan — webinar 'Hyperspace: Inference at Scale' launch thread. Need final post copy, hero image, and routing rules by EOD Wed.
Avery P: timeline ok. which windows for X vs LinkedIn? we should stagger by 6h to catch different comms windows.
Samir K: I put a draft schedule in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/xxx (tab: social-schedule). X: T0, T0+6h. LinkedIn: T0+3h. timezone = PST for publish times.
Rita L: @Jordan M routing question — how are inbound signups tagged? SDRs need clear source + urgency flag.
Jordan M: good Q. routing rules: if utm_campaign= hyperspace_launch and form_field=company_size>50 -> tag: "enterprise_lead" and route to team-enterprise. else -> tag: "inbound_webinar" -> sdr-rotation.
Samir K: here is a tiny CSV header example we can feed to the CRM import if needed:
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,utm_source,utm_campaign,lead_tag,priority
test@example.com,Pat,Lee,Acme,x,t_hyperspace,inbound_webinar,normal
```
Avery P: Copy options — keep short for X, longer for LinkedIn. Two X variants: A) "Hyperspace Webinar: Cut inference cost by 3x. Join our engineers Wed. RSVP.👇" B) "Running LLMs at scale? We’ll show batching, caching, and fallbacks. Wed — register.👇"
Avery P: LinkedIn variant: "Join Redwood engineers for 'Hyperspace: Inference at Scale' — actionable playbook on latency, cost, and rollout patterns. Save your seat -> [link]"
Rita L: prefer X variant B for the tech audience, A for product folks. tagging: add utm_medium=x_post and utm_content=variantA/B so we can trace engagement.
Samir K: Image checklist: 1200x628 for LinkedIn; 1600x900 for X hero. Also pls include 2 alt texts.
martech-bot: Scheduled preview (canary):
```
platform: x
publish_time: 2026-05-14T15:00:00-07:00
copy: "Running LLMs at scale? We’ll show batching, caching, and fallbacks. Wed — register.👇"
image: hyperspace-hero-v3.png
utm: utm_source=x&utm_campaign=hyperspace_launch&utm_content=variantB
```
Jordan M: Can we do a canary post T-24h to the smaller seedlist (5k) and measure CTR? if CTR> baseline*1.1 then go wide.
Avery P: yes — slot canary at T-24h. I'll set the seed audience (seedlist: webinar-seed-05k).
Rita L: when leads come in, SDR playbook: 1) immediate auto-email with calendar link, 2) tag lead with urgency if company_size>200 or job_title contains "Head"/"Director". If flagged, ping #sdr-live with lead row.
Samir K: UTM template for assets: ?utm_source={platform}&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=hyperspace_launch&utm_content={variant}&utm_term={audience}
Avery P: dropping final creative by Tue 10am PST into the sheet (assets tab). please react when uploaded.
Jordan M: perfect. @Rita L @Samir K once assets + utm confirmed i'll hand off scheduling to martech.
Rita L: noted. ping me when canary results are in.
Samir K: all set on image export. will include alt text + focal crops.
Avery P: quick QA checklist before scheduling: 1) final copy 2) hero PNG + 2 crops 3) alt text 4) landing page utm working 5) registration form test.
Jordan M: adding one more — run shortened headline A/B on X for first 2 hours only, then auto-merge winner.
Avery P: I'll configure A/B and auto-merge in the scheduler.
Rita L: thanks team. I'll prep the SDR playbook snippet and paste into the sheet.
Samir K: will update sheet with exact publish timestamps after creative drop.
Jordan M: sounds good. cheers :partyparrot: (reacts :thumbsup:)
